title: ClickStack - Operations Center
description: The single pane to open first: application request health, Kubernetes workload health, cluster resource utilization, log error signals, and recent cluster events — top signals from every ClickStack Grafana dashboard.

options.content:
## Operations Center
The single pane to open first: **is anything wrong right now, and where?** Top signals for application requests, Kubernetes health, resource utilization, logs, and recent cluster events — collected by the OpenTelemetry Collector and queried from ClickHouse. All panels honor the selected time range: **rates and percentiles cover the full range**, Kubernetes and utilization status use the **latest sample**, and time-series counts are **per chart interval**. Drill into **Infrastructure**, **Kubernetes**, **Service Health**, or **Logs** for detail. No data usually means telemetry isn't being collected — check the OTel Collector and the ClickHouse datasource.

panels.title: Average server request rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() / dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) AS value FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server'

panels.description: Average server requests per second over the selected time range. Each OpenTelemetry server span is counted as one request.

panels.title: Server request error rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / nullIf(count(), 0) AS value FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server'

panels.description: Percentage of server requests marked Error over the selected time range. Green below 1%, yellow 1–4.99%, red 5% or higher.

panels.title: 95th-percentile server latency

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6 AS value FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server'

panels.description: 95% of server requests completed within this duration during the selected time range.

panels.title: Services receiving requests

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT ServiceName) AS value FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server'

panels.description: Distinct service names that reported at least one server request during the selected time range.

panels.title: Server requests per chart interval

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, count() AS requests
FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Number of server requests in each automatic Grafana chart interval. Interval width changes when the time range changes.

panels.title: Server request error rate over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, 100 * countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / nullIf(count(), 0) AS error_pct
FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Percentage of server requests marked Error in each chart interval; lower is better.

panels.title: Ready nodes (latest in range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS value FROM (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] AS n, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM ${database}.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.node.condition_ready' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY n HAVING v = 1)

panels.description: Nodes whose latest Ready condition in the selected range is true. Compare with the expected cluster node count; any decrease requires investigation.

panels.title: Running pods (latest in range)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS value FROM (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS u, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM ${database}.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.phase' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY u HAVING v = 2)

panels.description: Pods whose latest phase in the selected range is Running. Successfully completed pods are not included.

panels.title: Pods pending, failed, or unknown

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS value FROM (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS u, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM ${database}.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.phase' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY u HAVING v NOT IN (2, 3))

panels.description: Pods whose latest phase is neither Running nor Succeeded. Any non-zero result should be investigated.

panels.title: Container restarts during selected range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(d) AS value FROM (
  SELECT concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'], '/', ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name']) AS c, max(Value) - min(Value) AS d
  FROM ${database}.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.container.restarts' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY c)

panels.description: Increase in container restart counters during the selected time range, summed across the cluster. Longer ranges may naturally produce larger totals.

panels.title: Cluster CPU utilization

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100 * avg(busy) AS value FROM (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['host.name'] AS host, Attributes['cpu'] AS cpu, TimeUnix,
         sumIf(Value, Attributes['state'] != 'idle') AS busy
  FROM ${database}.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'system.cpu.utilization' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY host, cpu, TimeUnix)

panels.description: Average non-idle CPU across every reporting host over the selected range. Green below 75%, yellow 75–89%, red 90% or higher. Open Infrastructure to see which host is hot.

panels.title: Cluster memory utilization

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * avgIf(Value, Attributes['state'] = 'used') AS value FROM ${database}.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'system.memory.utilization' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

panels.description: Average used-memory percentage across every reporting host over the selected range. Unlike CPU there is no throttling safety net — exhaustion triggers the OOM killer.

panels.title: Lowest volume free %

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100 * min(avail / nullIf(cap, 0)) AS value FROM (
  SELECT host, mountpoint, sumIf(v, st = 'free') AS avail, sum(v) AS cap FROM (
    SELECT ResourceAttributes['host.name'] AS host, Attributes['mountpoint'] AS mountpoint, Attributes['state'] AS st,
           argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
    FROM ${database}.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE MetricName = 'system.filesystem.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
    GROUP BY host, mountpoint, st)
  GROUP BY host, mountpoint)

panels.description: Free-space percentage on the most constrained mounted volume. That volume runs out first, so it governs the whole cluster — and because it is measured per volume, one full data disk cannot be hidden by healthy volumes on the same host. Open Infrastructure to see which volume it is.

panels.title: Cluster health score

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100 * n.ready * p.ok AS value
FROM (
  SELECT countIf(v = 1) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS ready FROM (
    SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] AS n, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
    FROM ${database}.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.node.condition_ready' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
    GROUP BY n)) n
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT countIf(v IN (2, 3)) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS ok FROM (
    SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS u, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
    FROM ${database}.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.phase' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
    GROUP BY u)) p

panels.description: Composite availability score: the share of nodes that are Ready multiplied by the share of pods that are Running or Succeeded, both from their latest sample. 100% means every node and every pod is where it should be; anything less means at least one is not.

panels.title: Average log record rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() / dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) AS value FROM ${database}.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

panels.description: Average number of log records ingested per second over the selected time range.

panels.title: Average error and fatal log rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf((SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal'))) / dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) AS value FROM ${database}.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

panels.description: Average error-or-higher log records per second (OpenTelemetry severity 17+ or Error/Fatal severity text).

panels.title: Error and fatal share of logs

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * countIf((SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal'))) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS value FROM ${database}.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

panels.description: Percentage of all log records classified as Error or Fatal. Green below 2%, yellow 2–9.99%, red 10% or higher.

panels.title: Fatal logs in selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf((SeverityNumber >= 21 OR lower(SeverityText) = 'fatal')) AS value FROM ${database}.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

panels.description: Total Fatal log records during the selected time range. Any non-zero value is red.

panels.title: Log records per interval by severity

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, multiIf(SeverityNumber >= 21, 'fatal', SeverityNumber >= 17, 'error', SeverityNumber >= 13, 'warn', SeverityNumber >= 9, 'info', SeverityNumber >= 5, 'debug', SeverityNumber >= 1, 'trace', SeverityText != '', lower(SeverityText), 'unspecified') AS severity, count() AS logs
FROM ${database}.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time, severity ORDER BY time

panels.description: Log record count in each chart interval, stacked by OpenTelemetry severity. Interval width changes with the selected time range.

panels.title: Error and fatal logs per interval by service

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, ServiceName AS service, count() AS errors
FROM ${database}.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND (SeverityNumber >= 17 OR lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal'))
GROUP BY time, service HAVING errors > 0 ORDER BY time

panels.description: Error-or-higher log record count per chart interval, grouped by reporting service.

panels.title: Service request health

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ServiceName AS "Service",
       round(count() / dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime), 2) AS "Req/s",
       countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') AS "Errors",
       round(100 * countIf(StatusCode = 'Error') / nullIf(count(), 0), 2) AS "Error %",
       round(quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e6, 1) AS "p95 ms"
FROM ${database}.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server'
GROUP BY ServiceName
ORDER BY "Error %" DESC, "Req/s" DESC

panels.description: Per-service request rate, error count, error percentage, and 95th-percentile latency over the selected time range, sorted by highest error percentage.

panels.title: Most recent Kubernetes events

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS "Time",
       JSONExtractString(Body, 'object', 'type') AS "Type",
       JSONExtractString(Body, 'object', 'reason') AS "Reason",
       concat(JSONExtractString(Body, 'object', 'regarding', 'kind'), ' ', JSONExtractString(Body, 'object', 'regarding', 'namespace'), '/', JSONExtractString(Body, 'object', 'regarding', 'name')) AS "Object",
       JSONExtractString(Body, 'object', 'note') AS "Message"
FROM ${database}.otel_logs
WHERE ScopeName LIKE '%k8sobjectsreceiver%' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.description: The 50 most recent Kubernetes events, newest first. Events are the cluster narrating what it did — scheduling decisions, image pulls, probe failures, evictions — and they are usually the fastest way to explain a status change you just saw above. See the Kubernetes dashboard for aggregated event analysis.
